{{nihongo|'''Takadahasagi Shrine'''|高田波蘇伎神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

'''Takadahasagi Shrine''' (たかだはさぎじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Takada|ja|高田 (一宮市)|qid=Q128848560|lt=Takada}}, {{ill|Ichinomiya, Aichi|ar|إيتشينوميا (آيتشي)|arz|ايتشينوميا|az|İçinomiya|azb|ایچینومیا، آیچی|bg|Ичиномия|ce|Итиномия|ceb|Ichinomiya (lungsod sa Hapon)|ckb|ئیچینۆمیا، ئایچی|cs|Ičinomija (Aiči)|dag|Ichinomiya|de|Ichinomiya (Aichi)|eo|Iĉinomija|es|Ichinomiya (Aichi)|eu|Ichinomiya (Aichi)|fa|ایچینومیا، آیچی|fi|Ichinomiya|fr|Ichinomiya|ga|Ichinomiya|gl|Ichinomiya|hy|Իչինոմիա|id|Ichinomiya, Aichi|it|Ichinomiya|ja|一宮市|ka|იტინომია|kk|Итиномия|ko|이치노미야시|lt|Ičinomija|mg|Ichinomiya|mzn|ایچینومیا، آیچی|nl|Ichinomiya (Aichi)|no|Ichinomiya|pl|Ichinomiya|pt|Owari-ichinomiya|ro|Ichinomiya, Aichi|ru|Итиномия|sh|Ichinomija|simple|Ichinomiya, Aichi|sr|Ичиномија|sv|Ichinomiya|tg|Ичиномия|th|อิจิโนมิยะ (จังหวัดไอจิ)|tl|Ichinomiya, Aichi|tr|Ichinomiya|tt|Итиномия|uk|Ітіномія (Айті)|ur|اچینومیا، ایچی|vi|Ichinomiya, Aichi|war|Ichinomiya, Aichi|wuu|一宫市|zh|一宮市|zh_classical|一宮市|zh_min_nan|Itinomiya-chhī|zh_yue|一宮|qid=Q270810}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|Q80434|qid=Q80434}}. Its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.

It is presumed to correspond to "Hasagi Shrine" in Nakashima District of {{ill|Owari Province|Q514506|qid=Q514506}} listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha register}}.

=== Overview ===
*Founding period unknown.
*In the {{ill|Muromachi period|ar|فترة موروماتشي|ast|Periodu Muromachi|bcl|Panahon nin Muromachi|be|Перыяд Мурамаці|bg|Муромачи|bn|মুরোমাচি যুগ|ckb|سەردەمی مرۆماچی|cs|Období Muromači|de|Muromachi-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Muromaĉi|es|Período Muromachi|eu|Muromachi aroa|fa|دوره موروماچی|fi|Muromachi-kausi|fr|Époque de Muromachi|gl|Período Muromachi|he|תקופת אשיקאגה|hu|Muromacsi-kor|id|Zaman Muromachi|it|Periodo Muromachi|ja|室町時代|ko|무로마치 시대|lt|Muromači laikotarpis|nl|Muromachiperiode|pl|Muromachi (okres)|pt|Período Muromachi|ru|Период Муромати|simple|Muromachi period|sk|Obdobie Muromači|sl|Obdobje Muromači|sr|Муромачи период|sv|Ashikaga|th|ยุคมูโรมาจิ|tl|Panahong Muromachi|tr|Muromachi Dönemi|uk|Період Муроматі|vi|Thời kỳ Muromachi|wuu|室町时代|zh|室町时代|zh_min_nan|Muromati sî-tāi|zh_yue|室町時代|qid=Q334845}}, Hasagi Shrine declined and the sacred body was temporarily moved to Shōhachimangū in Monma Village of {{ill|Haguri District|hu|Haguri körzet|ja|葉栗郡|ko|하구리군 (아이치현)|pl|Powiat Haguri|sr|Област Хагури|zh|葉栗郡|qid=Q1032507}} (now {{ill|Ifuribe Shrine|ja|伊富利部神社|qid=Q11379320}}).
*In the early {{ill|Edo period|ar|فترة إيدو|ast|Periodu Edo|az|Edo dövrü|bcl|Panahon nin Edo|be|Перыяд Эда|bg|Едо (период)|bn|এদো যুগ|bo|ཨེ་དོའི་དུས་སྐབས།|br|Marevezh Edo|ca|Període Edo|ckb|سەردەمی ئێدۆ|cs|Období Edo|cv|Эдо тапхăрĕ|da|Edo-perioden|de|Edo-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Edo|es|Período Edo|et|Edo ajastu|eu|Edo aroa|fa|دوره ادو|fi|Edo-kausi|fr|Époque d'Edo|gl|Período Edo|he|תקופת אדו|hi|एदो अवधी|hr|Edo (razdoblje)|hu|Edo-kor|id|Zaman Edo|is|Jedótímabilið|it|Periodo Edo|ja|江戸時代|jv|Jaman Édo|ko|에도 시대|lt|Edo laikotarpis|lv|Edo periods|mk|Едо (период)|mn|Эдогийн эрин|ms|Zaman Edo|nl|Edoperiode|nn|Edotida|oc|Periòde Edo|pl|Edo (okres)|pt|Período Edo|ro|Perioada Edo|ru|Период Эдо|simple|Edo period|sk|Obdobie Edo|sl|Obdobje Edo|sq|Periudha Edo|sr|Едо период|su|Période Edo|sv|Edoperioden|th|ยุคเอโดะ|tl|Panahong Edo|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Eto|tr|Edo Dönemi|uk|Період Едо|ur|ایڈو دور|uz|Edo davri|vi|Thời kỳ Edo|war|Panahon Edo|wuu|江戶時代|zh|江户时代|zh_min_nan|Edo sî-tāi|zh_yue|江戶時代|qid=Q184963}}, {{ill|Hachiman|Q261637|qid=Q261637|lt=Homudawake-no-Mikoto}} was enshrined at the former Hasagi Shrine site, and it became Hachiman-sha.
*In {{ill|1872|Q7753|qid=Q7753}} (Meiji 5) it became a village shrine, and in {{ill|1932|ab|1932|af|1932|als|1932|am|1932 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1932|ar|1932|ary|1932|arz|1932|ast|1932|av|1932|avk|1932|az|1932|azb|۱۹۳۲ (میلادی)|ba|1932 йыл|ban|1932|bar|1932|bat_smg|1932|bcl|1932|be|1932|be_x_old|1932|bg|1932|bh|1932|bn|১৯৩২|bpy|মারি ১৯৩২|br|1932|bs|1932.|ca|1932|cdo|1932 nièng|ce|1932 шо|ceb|1932|ckb|١٩٣٢|co|1932|crh|1932|cs|1932|csb|1932|cv|1932|cy|1932|da|1932|de|1932|diq|1932|dsb|1932|el|1932|eml|1932|eo|1932|es|1932|et|1932|eu|1932|ext|1932|fa|۱۹۳۲|fi|1932|fiu_vro|1932|fo|1932|fr|1932|frp|1932|frr|1932|fur|1932|fy|1932|ga|1932|gag|1932|gan|1932年|gcr|1932|gd|1932|gl|1932|gn|1932|gv|1932|hak|1932-ngièn|he|1932|hi|१९३२|hif|1932|hr|1932.|hsb|1932|ht|1932 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1932|hy|1932|hyw|1932 թուական|ia|1932|id|1932|ilo|1932|inh|1932 шу|io|1932|is|1932|it|1932|ja|1932年|jbo|1932moi|jv|1932|ka|1932|kaa|1932|kbp|1932|kg|1932|kk|1932 жыл|kn|೧೯೩೨|ko|1932년|krc|1932 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1932|ku|1932|kv|1932-ӧд во|kw|1932|la|1932|lb|1932|lez|1932 йис|li|1932|lij|1932|lmo|1932|ln|1932|lt|1932 m.|lv|1932. gads|mai|१९३२|map_bms|1932|mdf|1932|mg|1932|mhr|1932|mi|1932|min|1932|mk|1932|ml|1932|mn|1932 он|mr|इ.स. १९३२|mrj|1932 и|ms|1932|my|၁၉၃၂|myv|1932 ие|mzn|۱۹۳۲|nah|1932|nap|1932|nds|1932|nds_nl|1932|new|ई सं १९३२|nl|1932|nn|1932|no|1932|nov|1932|nrm|1932|nso|1932|oc|1932|olo|1932|or|୧୯୩୨|os|1932-æм аз|pa|1932|pam|1932|pap|1932|pl|1932|pnb|1932|pt|1932|qu|1932|ro|1932|roa_rup|1932|roa_tara|1932|ru|1932 год|rue|1932|sah|1932 сыл|sc|1932|scn|1932|sco|1932|sd|1932ع|se|1932|sh|1932.|shn|1932|si|1932|simple|1932|sk|1932|sl|1932|smn|1932|sq|1932|sr|1932|stq|1932|su|1932|sv|1932|sw|1932|szl|1932|ta|1932|te|1932|tg|Соли 1932|th|พ.ศ. 2475|tk|1932|tl|1932|tly|1932|tpi|1932|tr|1932|tt|1932 ел|ty|1932|udm|1932 ар|ug|1932 - يىلى|uk|1932|ur|1932ء|uz|1932|vec|1932|vi|1932|vls|1932|vo|1932|wa|1932|war|1932|xmf|1932|yi|1932|za|1932 nienz|zea|1932|zh|1932年|zh_classical|一九三二年|zh_min_nan|1932 nî|zh_yue|1932年|zu|1932|qid=Q18743}} (Shōwa 7) it became a gōsha.

=== Enshrined deities ===
*{{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997}}
*{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ōtsuoki-no-Mikoto}}
*:Said to be the father of {{ill|Ikagashikome|Q10885176|qid=Q10885176}}, {{ill|Empress consort|Q7723211|qid=Q7723211}} of {{ill|Emperor Kaika|Q333548|qid=Q333548}}, and regarded as ancestor of the {{ill|Mononobe clan|Q1755836|qid=Q1755836|lt=Mononobe no Muraji}}.

=== Transportation ===
*5 minutes on foot from "Takada" bus stop on {{ill|Meitetsu Bus|Q6810397|qid=Q6810397}}
**From {{ill|Meitetsu Ichinomiya Station|Q2856589|qid=Q2856589}} / {{ill|Owari-Ichinomiya Station|Q871495|qid=Q871495}} (platform 3 of Meitetsu Ichinomiya bus terminal): bound for "Yamasato Nishi" or "{{ill|Twin Arch 138|Q11318660|qid=Q11318660|lt=138 Tower Park}}"
